```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("patchwork")
library("scales")
library(lme4)       
library(glmmTMB)     
library(performance)
library(lmerTest)

setwd("C:/Users/bwvma/OneDrive - ucsc.edu/One Drive Back Up/R-Studio/Octodata")
Octo <- read_csv("Octo Trials Data (Control, Octo, Octo treatment) 2 3.csv")
```
```{r}

Prob_of_Movement_Data <- Octo |> 
   filter(Treatment != "Octo Eating") |>
  select(Treatment,`Movement? 2`) |> 
   mutate("Abalone" = row_number()) |> 
  rename(Movement_binary = `Movement? 2`)

Prob_of_Movement_Data
 
```
```{r}
model <- lm(Movement_binary ~ Treatment, data = Prob_of_Movement_Data)
summary(model)

```
```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

model_movement <- glmer(
  Movement_binary ~ Treatment + (1 | Abalone),
  data = Prob_of_Movement_Data,
  family = binomial
)
summary(model_movement)

#anova(model_movement, type = 3)

```
